AudioShare third-party notices

Interface notification tones are original synthesized sine tones; no external sound assets are used.

The Android APK retains its existing Kotlin/LiveKit dependency packaging. Upstream projects: https://github.com/livekit/client-sdk-android (Apache-2.0), AndroidX (Apache-2.0), Kotlin (Apache-2.0).
